parameters.query:
SELECT shop_domain
FROM henvalt.shopify_connections
WHERE active = true
  AND token_type = 'offline_expiring'
  AND access_token_expires_at <= now() + interval '10 minutes'
  AND refresh_token_expires_at > now()
  AND reauth_required_at IS NULL
  AND (token_refresh_lease_until IS NULL OR token_refresh_lease_until <= now())
ORDER BY access_token_expires_at ASC
LIMIT 25

parameters.jsCode:
const v = $("Validate AI Output").item.json || {};
const created = $("Create Delivery Request").item.json || {};
return { json: {
  delivery_request_id: created.delivery_request_id,
  message_id: $("Render & Queue Message").item.json.message_id,
  tenant_id: v.tenant_id,
  recovery_id: v.recovery_id,
  opportunity_id: v.opportunity_id,
  intervention_id: v.intervention_id,
  channel: "EMAIL",
  to: v.recipient,
  subject: v.subject,
  html_body: v.body_html,
  text_body: v.body_text,
  tracking_token: v.tracking_token,
  correlation_id: v.correlation_id,
  idempotency_key: v.idempotency_key,
  recovery_type: v.recovery_type
} };

const context = {
  recovery_type: "ABANDONED_CHECKOUT",
  step_number: 1,
  previous_messages: [],
  store_name: "My Store",
  customer_first_name: null,
  products: [],
  cart_or_checkout_value: 229650,
  currency: "PKR",
  brand_tone: "friendly",
  email_branding: { primary_color: "#171717", background_color: "#F4F4F1", accent_color: "#77776F" },
  recovery_context: "A real Shopify checkout opportunity is eligible. Use only the fact that the customer can return to their checkout.",
  destination_url: "VERIFIED_SHOPIFY_CHECKOUT_DESTINATION"
};
const system = [
"You are a senior lifecycle copywriter. Write a calm, warm, premium abandoned-CHECKOUT email.",
"Use checkout only. Never say cart, browsing, visiting, noticed, saw, left, tracked, saved, reserved, or still open.",
"Do not invent a customer name, product fact, availability, shipping promise, discount, urgency, deadline, guarantee, or support promise.",
"Do not mention price. No links or URLs.",
"Use exactly this safe message structure and meaning; polish only lightly, do not add claims:",
"Subject: Your checkout, whenever you're ready",
"Opening: Hi there,",
"Body: If you'd still like to place your order, you can return to your checkout whenever it suits you. If you have a question before deciding, simply reply to this email. No pressure at all.",
"CTA: Return to your checkout",
"Return strict JSON only with keys subject, opening, body, cta_text. The body must not repeat the greeting."
].join(" ");
const user = "Authoritative preview context (JSON): " + JSON.stringify(context);
return [{json:{model:"openai/gpt-oss-120b",temperature:0.1,response_format:{type:"json_object"},messages:[{role:"system",content:system},{role:"user",content:user}],preview_context:context}}];
